note: What each observable packet stream and each system capability depends on, read from firmware source. tests/test_ground_status_model.py fails if a pinned source line stops matching, so a firmware change forces this model to be re-read. A source pin shows the dependency is implemented; it does not show hardware behaves that way. Every entry's bench evidence is NOT MEASURED until an accepted inert session shows it.

channels.name: Rocket telemetry (T + STATUS)
channels.why: The launcher relays T and STATUS only from a rocket DATA line, and the rocket loop returns before DATA when the MPU6050 failed at boot.

channels.name: Launcher environment (ENV)
channels.why: ENV is sent once a second from the tail of the launcher main loop, so it pauses while the launcher waits inside the arming window, the ignition wait, or the abort latch.

channels.name: Launcher heading ([FUSION])
channels.why: A compass reading of all zeros returns before the [FUSION] packet. It shares the loop tail with ENV, so it is only meaningful while ENV is flowing.

channels.name: GPS NMEA stream (ENV gps_state above 0)
channels.why: gps_state is 0 when no GPS characters arrived since the previous ENV.

source.contains: gpsState = 0; // Module stopped sending or disconnected

channels.name: Barometric altitude (ENV alt finite)
channels.why: The launcher sends nan when the barometer failed at boot.

channels.name: Log-dump reply (LOG_START ... LOG_END)
channels.why: The rocket handles commands before its MPU6050 check, so a rocket with a failed IMU still answers DUMPLOG. That reply separates an IMU fault from a UART or rocket fault.

capabilities.name: Arming switch returns the launcher to SAFE
capabilities.why: Gate G-01 runs on the launcher alone; the dashboard and rocket are not involved.

capabilities.name: Launcher aborts READY on lost rocket heartbeat
capabilities.why: Gate G-03 is the launcher's response to losing the rocket, so it survives UART, rocket, and IMU faults.

capabilities.name: Rocket centers canards and holds ignition off without an IMU
capabilities.why: The rocket's failed-IMU branch needs only the rocket processor.

capabilities.name: Launcher can reach READY
capabilities.why: Gate G-02 needs a rocket READY line, and the rocket suppresses READY without an IMU. The dashboard link is not required.

capabilities.name: Abort reasons reach the session record
capabilities.why: The launcher still aborts without a link, but the reason then never reaches the dashboard CSV.

capabilities.name: Live roll, rate, servo, and state on the dashboard
capabilities.why: Same path as the rocket telemetry channel.

capabilities.name: Onboard log dump can be requested and received
capabilities.why: Same path as the log-dump reply; a rocket whose IMU failed at boot answers with an empty log.

capabilities.name: Controller gains can be changed
capabilities.why: The launcher forwards valid PID lines and the rocket applies them before its IMU check.

capabilities.name: A gain change can be confirmed by telemetry
capabilities.why: Firmware sends no acknowledgement; only STATUS shows the active gains, and STATUS needs the IMU path.

capabilities.name: Launcher position on the dashboard
capabilities.why: Latitude and longitude are placeholders unless gps_state is 2.

capabilities.name: Barometric altitude on the dashboard
capabilities.why: Same path as the altitude channel.

capabilities.name: Launcher heading on the dashboard
capabilities.why: Same path as the heading channel. Its tilt correction also reads relayed rocket IMU values, which stay zero without rocket telemetry.

absent_capabilities.name: Returning an armed rocket to IDLE without a restart
absent_capabilities.why: The only IDLE assignment in the rocket firmware is its initial value, and the launcher's abort path sends the rocket nothing. See discrepancy D-025.

absent_capabilities.name: The launcher reporting SAFE, ARMING, READY, or IGNITING to the dashboard
absent_capabilities.why: STATUS carries the rocket's state. The dashboard can only infer the launcher's state.

absent_capabilities.name: A rocket heartbeat that does not depend on the IMU
absent_capabilities.why: The launcher accepts an ALIVE line as a heartbeat, but the rocket never sends one, so a failed IMU looks the same as a dead rocket until a log dump is requested.

not_modeled: Sensor failure after boot: mpuHealthy and bmpHealthy are set only in setup(), so firmware keeps reporting whatever the driver returns. The IMU-frozen advisory is a heuristic for the rocket side; nothing covers the barometer.
Partial faults: a slow, noisy, or intermittent unit is modeled as working while its packets arrive on time.
One-way link faults: LINK and UART are each treated as a single unit, not two directions.
Common causes: a shared supply or I2C bus is not a unit, so a brownout appears as several unit failures.
